# Antonio (Paulo) Inguane

> International Development specialist with 15+ years of field experience in public policy, natural resource management, land tenure and environment, across 12 countries in Africa, the Americas and Oceania.

Antonio (Paulo) Inguane is Co-Founder and Advisor at Data4Moz and Data4Angola, and Managing Director of Mozambique Flying Labs. His work centers on land policy, environmental governance, GIS and geospatial analysis, and stakeholder engagement between communities, governments, donors and implementing partners. He has conducted field work in Mozambique, the United States, Zimbabwe, Angola, Madagascar, Australia, South Africa, Zambia, Gambia, Malawi, Cameroon and Brazil.
